item.description:
Teleprompter, Pomodoro, Weather, and a smarter Calendar

  • Teleprompter — a new module for reading scripts in front of the camera with adjustable scroll speed.
  • Pomodoro — a third mode in the Timer module, alongside countdown and stopwatch.
  • Weather per clock — current condition and temperature on every Clocks tile, via Open-Meteo (no API key, no account).
  • Create events from the notch — inline new-event editor in the Calendar drawer. Title, date, time, duration, and calendar pulldown, all without leaving Ledge.
  • Busy / free check across time zones — when scrubbing a time in Clocks, each tile shows a pink “busy” pill or quiet green “free” dot derived from today’s calendar — so you can answer “is 3pm in Tokyo a good time?” without leaving the panel.

Calendar, volume, time conversion + lots of polish

  • Calendar module — today's agenda and next meeting at a glance, with join buttons for video links.
  • Volume + AirPlay — control system output volume from Now Playing; one-click AirPlay picker.
  • Time conversion in Clocks — type “3pm Dubai” and see your local time.
  • Now Playing — album art for streaming Apple Music tracks, smooth progress bar, Love button.
  • Notch is rounder and sits flush on external displays.
  • Bitcoin sparkline polish, design-system pass across all modules.

Changes in 1.0.4

  • Actually fix the Settings crash. 1.0.3 patched a symptom but missed the real root cause; 1.0.4 fixes the bundle-loading path the Shortcuts pane needs.

Changes in 1.0.3

  • Fix crash in Settings → Shortcuts on macOS 26 (Tahoe).

Polish for the Clocks module + a hover sensitivity control.

Clocks

  • 5+ clocks now wrap cleanly as 3+2 / 3+3 instead of clipping behind the panel; the panel grows to fit.
  • Refined tile look — bigger 72×72 faces, filled card backgrounds, larger time digits, tracked uppercase city labels.
  • A small green dot marks your local timezone so you can spot “this is you” at a glance.
  • New searchable city picker in Settings → Clocks: every timezone macOS knows about (~600 cities), with a Popular section at the top. Each row shows city, IANA path, and GMT offset.

Hover sensitivity

Settings → General → Activation gets a 4-preset picker: Instant · Default · Relaxed · Patient. If you keep accidentally triggering Ledge while reaching for the menu bar, dial it up.

1.0.1 — Timer panel sizing fix

Fixes the Timer module's panel being too short, which caused the top of the content (mode toggle, presets) to clip behind the notch. Bumps the panel to a height that fits the post-Stopwatch layout cleanly.

The big 1.0 — three new modules, on-device OCR, and signed auto-updates.

New modules

  • Clipboard — manual stash for text, images, and files. Press ⌃⌥V or drag onto the notch. Rich text preserved. On-device OCR via Vision makes screenshot text searchable. Pin entries, edit them as snippets, full keyboard nav, Quick Look any row with space. Concealed-clipboard hints from password managers are honored.
  • Notes — daily notepad with auto-rollover. Today is editable; at midnight it slides into a scrollable archive that renders markdown.
  • Stopwatch — new mode in the Timer module, drift-free pause and resume.

Auto-updates

From this release on, Ledge updates itself with a clean prompt — no more manual DMG re-downloads. Updates are signed with an EdDSA key; the app refuses anything unsigned. The only network call for updates is the appcast at satsdisco.github.io/ledge.

Polish

  • Timer / stopwatch layout balanced vertically in the panel
  • File Shelf expanded view layout matches other modules
  • Settings → Shortcuts now lists every Clipboard-panel keystroke plus tips
